description: Episodic retrieval queries for the Task 3(d) weighting comparison. Gold answers are identified by episode type and source turn, because episode IDs are assigned at run time. Queries Q-E01 to Q-E03 are the E-category probes P05, P06 and P13 verbatim; Q-E04 and Q-E05 are scripted Session B turns 28 and 29. The others are additional paraphrases written for this comparison, including recency-sensitive queries.
evaluated_against: memory state saved at the end of Session A, queried with the Session B logical clock (2026-11-24 10:00 +05:30 and later)
